preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 2 and 100,000.
The total number of vertices across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(k) + '\n' + '\n'.join(f'{x1} {y1} {x2} {y2}' for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations)
postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum number of operations k followed by k lines of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x1 <= n and 1 <= y1 <= n and 1 <= x2 <= n and 1 <= y2 <= n for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations)
postconditions.description: All vertices in the operations must be within the valid range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(x1 != y1 and x2 != y2 for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations)
postconditions.description: The edges being removed and added must connect distinct vertices.
